# Version 4.151.0
> **Performance and WASM .NET 11 support** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and delivers a broad managed-layer performance sweep with WASM .NET 11 support. A wave of allocation-free optimisations cuts overhead in HarfBuzzSharp buffer encoding, shaper span reads, tag parsing, and SKColor conversions. The WASM target gains Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries for .NET 11, and a CPU raster regression introduced upstream is restored.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia milestone m151** — The bundled Skia engine advances to m151 with multiple upstream cherry-pick syncs that apply rendering correctness and stability fixes. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))
- **CPU raster shader context restored to fix rendering regression** — An upstream change removed SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT, causing a CPU raster rendering regression. The flag is restored to keep existing raster output correct while the longer-term migration is planned. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## API Surface

- **SKColor hex parsing with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads** — SKColor.Parse and TryParse gain ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads, reducing allocations in hot parsing paths. Hex parsing is also optimised internally. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) fixed** — A native handle was not released when the crop-rect overload succeeded, leaking one native image reference per call. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **Allocation-heavy hot paths optimised** — HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) is now allocation-free via a pooled UTF-8 encoder. Tag.Parse in HarfBuzzSharp and SKFourByteTag eliminate a per-call char[4] heap allocation. SKShaper reads glyph results via zero-copy spans. SKColor and SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply conversions are ported to managed integer math, removing P/Invoke round-trips. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **WASM SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition warning resolved** — A macro redefinition in the Skia submodule caused a build warning on WASM. The submodule is updated to drop the duplicate definition. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3788))
- **Unnecessary unsafe modifier removed from GRContextOptions** — The unsafe keyword on GRContextOptions had no effect and was removed, keeping the public API surface clean. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Platform

- **WASM support for .NET 11 via Emscripten 5.0.6** — New Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries ship the WASM native assets for .NET 11, including builds with the new exnref exception-handling model required by the upcoming runtime. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships allocation-free UTF-8 buffer encoding via a pooled encoder, eliminates per-call char[4] heap allocations in Tag.Parse, and extends WASM support to .NET 11 via Emscripten 5.0.6.

## Release Candidate 1 (July 21, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 added preview-.NET WASM tests to catch exception-handling regressions, delivered Emscripten 5.0.6 exnref builds, restored the CPU raster shader context to fix a rendering regression, and merged the final upstream m151 stability fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.2.1...v4.151.0-rc.1.1)

## Preview 2 (July 14, 2026)

Preview 2 delivered the performance sweep: allocation-free HarfBuzzSharp UTF-8 encoding, zero-copy SKShaper span reads, eliminated tag-parse heap allocations, managed SKColor/SKPMColor conversions, and the SKColor ReadOnlySpan<char> parsing overloads.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.1.1...v4.151.0-preview.2.1)
